title: Guided rollout tour: pin-by-severity + staged canary heatmap visuals
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design assets and annotated screenshots for a new guided onboarding tour focused on Rollouts and Version Pinning. This ticket covers: a) a step-by-step quickstart overlay that teaches users how to create a staged canary rollout, b) a compact pin-by-severity UI pattern (ability to pin a version for specific traffic buckets or severity levels), and c) heatmap + timeline visuals that surface traffic distribution during A/B and canary experiments and show automatic fallback triggers. Goals: reduce first-time configuring rollouts by 40%, improve discoverability of pinning, and provide clear visual signals for fallback states and rollbacks.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity overlay screens (desktop) for the guided tour: intro -> create rollout -> pin version -> configure fallback
Annotated screenshots that match Redwood Console styling tokens and include copy for tooltips and microcopy
A compact 'pin-by-severity' component design with hover states and accessible keyboard interactions
Heatmap + timeline mockups that illustrate traffic split over time and highlight when fallback policy engages
Asset package (SVGs, PNGs, Annotated Figma frames) uploaded to the project drive and referenced in this ticket
Design QA checklist completed and handed off to FE with documented edge cases for long model names and multiple fallback tiers
mockup_notes: Primary view is a 1280px canvas (desktop). Overlay uses 72% opacity backdrop and 16px rounded cards. Heatmap rows correspond to model variants; time buckets are 5m. Fallback states use a red/amber/green triage visual with iconography to indicate automatic rollback, soft-fallback (re-route to fallback model), and manual pause. Pin-by-severity supports custom severity labels (error/warning/info) and a '+Add bucket' microflow. Include keyboard shortcut hint 'r' to open rollouts panel in the quickstart overlay.
